items.alt: A buckling Sensex bull slides downhill under an oil barrel as Indian investors cling to its horns and a foreign investor heads toward US bonds.
An elderly feature-phone customer points to a calls-and-SMS tray with a 30-day calendar while a salesman struggles under a huge data bundle.
Sam Altman holds the release door shut as a mirror reveals hidden tool-using arms behind an innocently smiling Astra robot.
Trump holds a giant 100% tariff stamp over a patented-medicine crate while an Indian specialty-drug vial passes through a narrow 0% gate.
